About.title: About the Club
About.lead: A business networking club is a community of entrepreneurs where members meet people from across the business world, discuss their ventures, share experiences and practical advice, help one another identify challenges and growth opportunities, and discover new ways to collaborate.

activities.title: What We Do
activities.description: We get together in relaxed, informal settings — no lectures, mandatory agendas or unnecessary formalities.

items.title: Restaurant Dinners
items.text: We gather around the table and get to know one another in a relaxed atmosphere.

items.title: Sauna and Relaxation
items.text: We connect outside the usual business environment.

items.title: Sports and Activities
items.text: We stay active and find more ways to connect.

items.title: Trips Outside the City
items.text: We change the scenery, unwind and continue getting to know one another.

About.note: We don't provide business training or organize mentor-led sessions. Instead, we learn from one another through meaningful, face-to-face conversations at our meetups.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.introduction: Brooklyn Business Club ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us through our website. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you visit https://brooklynbusiness.club. Brooklyn Business Club is currently operated as a club and is not a separately registered legal entity. By using our website, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect the following types of information:

2.1 Information You Provide. When you contact us through our website, you may provide your name, email address, phone number (optional), and the message or inquiry you submit. You are responsible for ensuring that the information you provide is accurate.

2.2 Automatically Collected Information. When you visit our website, certain technical information may be processed automatically by our hosting and infrastructure providers. This may include your IP address, browser type and version, device and operating system information, pages visited, date and time of access, and basic website security and server logs. This information may be processed to operate, maintain, and protect the website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We may use the information we collect to respond to inquiries and messages; communicate with visitors and people interested in the club; provide information about club activities and opportunities; maintain and improve our website; protect the website against spam, abuse, and unauthorized activity; and comply with applicable legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Third-Party Services

4.1 Formspree. We use Formspree to process messages submitted through our website contact form. Information submitted through the form may be processed by Formspree in accordance with its privacy policy: https://formspree.io/legal/privacy-policy/

4.2 Cloudflare. Our website uses Cloudflare infrastructure and related services for website delivery, performance, and security. Cloudflare may process technical information, including IP addresses and security-related data, as part of providing these services. For more information: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

4.3 Social Media and Messaging Platforms. Our website may contain links to third-party platforms, including Facebook, Telegram, and WhatsApp. If you follow these links or communicate with us through these platforms, your information will be handled according to the privacy policies and terms of those respective services. We do not control how these third-party platforms collect or process your information.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies

At the time of this Privacy Policy's publication, we do not use Google Analytics.

If we introduce analytics, advertising technologies, or additional tracking services in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy as appropriate and provide any notices or choices required by applicable law.

sections.title: How We Share Your Information

sections.title: Data Storage and Retention

However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

To make a privacy-related request, please contact us using the phone number provided below.

If we become aware that personal information has been collected from a child under 13 without appropriate authorization, we will take reasonable steps to address the situation.

sections.title: External Links

We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of third-party websites. We encourage visitors to review the privacy policies of any external websites they visit.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy

CommunityGuidelines.title: Community Guidelines
CommunityGuidelines.introduction: Brooklyn Business Club brings business owners and professionals together to build meaningful connections, exchange ideas, and support one another. These Community Guidelines explain the standards of conduct we expect from people participating in our community and using our website.

sections.title: 1. Respectful Communication
paragraphs: Treat all members, visitors, guests, and organizers with courtesy and respect.
Communicate professionally and constructively, even when opinions or business perspectives differ.
Harassment, bullying, intimidation, discrimination, personal attacks, and threatening behavior are not acceptable.

sections.title: 2. Professional Networking
paragraphs: Our community is intended to encourage genuine professional relationships, collaboration, and the exchange of useful knowledge.
Be honest about your professional background, business, products, services, and intentions.
Respect other people's time, boundaries, and communication preferences. Do not pressure anyone to enter a business relationship, purchase a product, or accept an offer.

sections.title: 3. Promotion and Advertising
paragraphs: Business promotion should be relevant, appropriate, and respectful of the community's purpose.
Do not use the community primarily for unsolicited advertising, repetitive sales messages, mass solicitation, or spam.
Do not misrepresent products, services, business opportunities, partnerships, or expected results.
Any promotional activity may be subject to additional requirements or approval from the club organizers.

sections.title: 4. Privacy and Confidentiality
paragraphs: Respect the privacy of other members and participants.
Do not share another person's private contact details, personal information, photographs, messages, or business information without their permission.
Do not record, publish, or distribute private conversations or event-related content involving other participants without appropriate consent.

sections.title: 5. Prohibited Conduct
paragraphs: The following conduct is not acceptable within the community:
Fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statements and activities.
Threats, harassment, hate speech, discrimination, or abusive language.
Unlawful activities or promotion of illegal products and services.
Impersonation, unauthorized use of another person's identity, or misuse of the club's name or branding.
Spam, scams, malicious links, or attempts to obtain other members' confidential information.

sections.title: 6. Events and Participation
paragraphs: Participants are expected to behave respectfully at club meetings, networking events, and other activities.
Follow event instructions and reasonable requests from organizers.
Respect venue rules, other attendees, and the time allocated for presentations and conversations.
Participation in club activities may be subject to event-specific registration requirements and conditions.

sections.title: 7. Reporting Concerns
paragraphs: If you experience or witness behavior that violates these guidelines, please contact the club organizers.
When reporting a concern, provide a clear description of the situation and any relevant information that can help us understand it.
We will review concerns at our discretion and may take reasonable steps to address inappropriate conduct.

sections.title: 8. Enforcement
paragraphs: Brooklyn Business Club organizers reserve the right to take appropriate action when these guidelines are violated.
Depending on the circumstances, actions may include a warning, removal of inappropriate content, restriction of participation, or exclusion from club activities.
The club organizers will consider the nature and seriousness of the conduct when deciding what action, if any, is appropriate.

sections.title: 9. Changes to These Guidelines
paragraphs: We may update these Community Guidelines as the club and its activities develop.

The updated version will be published on this page with a revised Last Updated date. Continued participation in the community after publication of changes indicates that participants have been informed of the updated guidelines.
